targets.name: HIV-1 protease
targets.blurb: Homodimeric aspartic protease. The catalytic Asp25/Asp25' dyad sits under a pair of flexible flaps that close over the bound inhibitor.

targets.name: EGFR kinase domain
targets.blurb: Receptor tyrosine kinase. Inhibitors here occupy the ATP site, hydrogen bonding to the Met793 hinge (Met769 in this numbering).
